subject: Software Engineer / Backend Platform - Pratham Modi (Val Town)
body:
Hi Steve,

I have been closely following Val Town and your work on Serverless JS/TS runtime in the browser and cloud platform, and wanted to reach out regarding engineering roles.

I am a Backend / Distributed Systems Engineer with production experience architecting high-throughput microservices, real-time event-driven pipelines (Kafka, Redis, PostgreSQL), and cloud-native infrastructure on AWS/GCP. In past systems, I have designed fault-tolerant APIs handling millions of requests with sub-50ms latencies and zero-downtime migrations.

Given Val Towns scale and product trajectory, I would love the opportunity to contribute directly to your core platform and backend services.

I have attached my base resume for your review. Would you be open to a brief 10-minute chat this week?

Best regards,
